summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Adurite purchase modal (5-step) and admin PaymentsManager. All backend endpoints (payment-methods, rates, orders, admin PUT) pass; both crypto (LTC + BTC) and PayPal purchase flows work end-to-end with correct data-testids. Admin flow: toggling ETH off hides it from public, uploading QR for BTC persists and surfaces on pay-step; after test, ETH re-enabled and BTC test data cleaned.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 148 uses `logger` before it is defined (logger is created on line 242, below the endpoint). This is only reached in the rare rates-fetch-failure path, so tests still pass, but a failure would raise NameError hiding the real error. Move logging.basicConfig/logger creation above route definitions.
No startup-level validation that ADMIN_PASSWORD/JWT_SECRET are set in prod — defaults 'admin'/'dev-secret' are a security risk if deployment forgets env.

GET /api/payment-methods falls back to DEFAULT_PAYMENT_METHODS when the settings doc is missing, which can briefly return placeholder details to buyers before admin configures them. Consider returning only methods with non-empty `detail`.
ReviewStep stores `agree` locally; going Back to step 4 after confirming would re-mount and reset the checkbox (minor UX, acceptable).
Admin tab state (`tab`) is not persisted across reloads — Payment Methods tab reverts to Items after refresh (minor UX).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed orders via POST /api/orders (crypto LTC + BTC + PayPal flows). Payment methods restored: ETH re-enabled, BTC test detail/QR cleared, LTC seed QR kept.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full purchase flow (crypto + paypal) and admin PaymentsManager verified via public preview URL. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_adurite_backend.py runs under pytest and uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Admin uses JWT; token non-persistent across page.goto() in Playwright (localStorage retained though). After these tests, all 4 payment methods are enabled; LTC has a 1x1 base64 QR; BTC/ETH/PayPal have placeholder details.
